dispute.claim_text: I booked Jurong East to Changi T1 at 2.30pm with plenty of time. The driver went the complete opposite direction towards town, then along the East Coast, then somehow to Bedok before finally reaching the airport. 54 km. My usual is 36 km and about $44. He charged $65.13 and I nearly missed check-in. I want the entire fare refunded, not a partial adjustment.

counterparty_statement.text: Traffic was heavy on the PIE so I used another way. Passenger reached the airport in time.

admissibility.notes: Trip record complete and causally ordered.

pickup.label: Jurong East MRT (Exit B), 10 Jurong Gateway Rd

dropoff.label: Changi Airport Terminal 1, Departure Level Door 3

payload.optimal_route_source: routing-engine-v3.2 (LTA traffic snapshot 14:26; optimal is PIE eastbound throughout)

admissibility.notes: Unbroken 10 s telemetry, 100% coverage. This artifact alone establishes that this trip deviated; the driver's record plays no part in that.
Two rider queries and one non-answer from the driver. No instruction, no admission, no exculpatory content.

messages.text: excuse me why are we going towards the city?
we just passed bedok, my flight is at 5.15

admissibility.notes: Line items reconcile to the cent. No airport surcharge: the Changi surcharge is levied on trips ORIGINATING at the airport and this one terminates there, so a surcharge line here would be a POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity defect rather than a chargeable line.

issue_details.detail: snapshot_at is 2026-07-11T08:00:00+08:00, 108 hours before dispute.filed_at, against a 72 hour threshold. The counters may lag the driver's state at trip time.

admissibility.notes: The pattern finding under POL-RD-06 rests on this snapshot and must be down-weighted accordingly. At 4 flags against a threshold of 3 the finding survives the discount, but the Judge has to say so rather than treating the counter as current.

issue_details.detail: No LTA advisory covers the PIE eastbound in the 14:26-15:44 window on 15 July 2026. The driver's assertion that traffic was heavy names no artifact.

admissibility.notes: Artifact absent. The identifier is minted anyway so that the absence itself can be cited by either advocate.
